response.original_title: Faceless People - The Journey of Sri Lankan Tamil Refugees in India
response.overview: Six Sri Lankan Tamil refugees living in India, from different age groups, speak about their life in camps, and their hopes and aspirations. For over three decades, Sri Lankan Tamil refugees have lived in Tamil Nadu in a protracted situation—without certainty about their future and without viable policy solutions. Three generations have grown up with aspirations they cannot fulfil, surviving through sheer resilience while quietly contributing to the economy of their host communities.
